svg.title: Writing calendar · human words per day, indexed in Korpus
svg.desc: Calendar of human words written per day over 26 weeks (2026-04-20 to 2026-10-13), indexed in Korpus: 549,425 words on 148 days, plus weekly counts of indexed workspace commits since 2026-09-02.

text.style: font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;
